# RINGANA — brand guide

## Audience
Adults interested in natural wellbeing; RINGANA customers and partners. For supplements such as
BEYOND omega, especially people who eat little or no fish.

## Tone
Clear, warm and factual: one idea per shot, short sentences, no hype. Show origin, benefit and
proof; never overpromise.

## Language
On-screen text and voice-over in English.

## Naming and brand mark
- Products are named as on the official product page, with the brand first: "RINGANA BEYOND omega".
- No official logo file yet: the brand mark is the name set in text (Montserrat 800).

## Claim rules
- Health claims only in the wording authorised by EU Reg. 432/2012 (e.g. "normal heart function",
  "normal brain function", "normal vision"), and only when the product meets the claim's conditions.
- Never "prevents", "treats", "cures" or "fights" a disease, and no claim the official product page
  does not make.
- RINGANA's own studies are attributed on screen as "RINGANA study", with the sample size; never
  presented as independent science.
- Every fact on screen comes from the official product page or a RINGANA source, listed in the
  video's fact sheet.

## Mandatory text
Food supplements close with the disclaimer, held long enough to read:
"Food supplement. Not a substitute for a varied diet or medical advice. Adults only."
When a RINGANA study is cited, add its footnote, e.g. "*RINGANA internal study, 27 participants, 2024."

## Preferred style
"Bright science": dark sea background, flat shading with a glow on the focal object, layered
depth, simple organ icons; light from the top-left. Text slides in with `cubic-out` and fades
out with `cubic-in`; every shot has ambient motion.

## Format and length
Reels and TikTok, 1080×1920, 30 fps.
- Default 15–30 s (20 s): explanatory reels aim at completion.
- 45–60 s only when reach is the goal, as a deliberate choice.
- Never over 90 s.
Each brief sets its own duration.
